mapper.insert: INSERT INTO KG_PAYMENT ( SVC_ID, MOBIL_ID, TRADE_ID, PRDT_NM, PRDT_PRICE, RESULT_CD, SIGN_DATE, USER_ID, USER_NAME, PAYER_EMAIL, INTEREST, CARD_NUM, CARD_CODE, CARD_NAME, APPR_NO, OWN_DIV_CD, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{svcId}, #{mobilId}, #{tradeId}, #{prdtNm}, #{prdtPrice}, #{resultCd}, #{signDate}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{payerEmail}, #{interest}, #{cardNum}, #{cardCode}, #{cardName}, #{apprNo}, #{ownDivCd}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT KG_SEQ AS kgSeq, SVC_ID AS svcId, MOBIL_ID AS mobilId, TRADE_ID AS tradeId, PRDT_NM AS prdtNm, PRDT_PRICE AS prdtPrice, RESULT_CD AS resultCd, SIGN_DATE AS signDate, USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, PAYER_EMAIL AS payerEmail, INTEREST AS interest, CARD_NUM AS cardNum, CARD_CODE AS cardCode, CARD_NAME AS cardName, APPR_NO AS apprNo, OWN_DIV_CD AS ownDivCd, REG_DATE AS regDate FROM KG_PAYMENT WHERE TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT KG_SEQ AS kgSeq, SVC_ID AS svcId, TRADE_ID AS tradeId, PRDT_NM AS prdtNm, PRDT_PRICE AS prdtPrice, RESULT_CD AS resultCd, SIGN_DATE AS signDate, USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, CARD_NAME AS cardName, APPR_NO AS apprNo, REG_DATE AS regDate FROM KG_PAYMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY KG_SEQ DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
